params.name: types
params.description: Comma-separated list of types to search (agents,tasks,workspaces). If not provided, searches all types.

params.name: namespace_id
params.description: Optional namespace ID to filter results

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results per type (max 50)

items.docs:
Unified search endpoint for agents, tasks, and workspaces.

    Searches by name using case-insensitive matching.
    Results are sorted by relevance (exact matches first, then prefix matches, then contains).
